caption: The drawing depicts two vests, each paired with a fabric swatch. The upper vest is illustrated in light tan or cream color with a subtle repeating pattern of small blue motifs, five buttons along the front, two horizontal pockets, and a shawl collar; next to it, on the upper left, is a square swatch of fabric with a matching light background and blue and light brown leaf-shaped motifs. The lower vest is rendered in dark brown or black with a faint sheen and a subtle pattern of small red crosses, also featuring five buttons down the front, two horizontal pockets, and a shawl collar; to the right of this vest is a fabric swatch in the same dark color and embroidery. The drawing is set on a plain beige background and includes handwritten text beneath each vest: "Westchester County" under the lower vest and "drawn by S. DiStange" at the bottom right.
title: Waistcoats
